title: Attribution tab never renders instrument learning; holdings mislabels a missing mark as no average cost

hosted_verification.statement: The hosted page was not verified in a browser by this task; this file records local unit, component, contract-drift, i18n parity, typecheck, lint, and production build verification only.

ac1_instrument_learning_and_instrument_b.detail: PerformanceAttribution.tsx renders summary.instrument_learning as separate figures (direction_hit_rate with direction_hit_count over direction_graded_count, instrument_regret with instrument_regret_graded_count, margin_use, and decision_count, showing an em dash '—' for null values) and a per-decision table with decision_id, chosen_instrument_id, best_instrument_id, direction_hit, instrument_regret, margin_use, and chosen_pnl. It also renders summary.instrument_breakdown as rows with instrument_key, instrument_kind, contract_month, multiplier, margin_reserved, holding_count, market_value, total_pnl, unrealized_pnl, and realized_pnl directly from BFF values without recomputation. PerformanceAttribution.test.tsx covers both the real 2026-11-10 all-null hosted payload and a graded payload in en-US and zh-TW.

ac2_adapter_snake_case_summary_and_contr.detail: src/lib/v5/management/performanceAttribution.ts defines AttributionInstrumentLearningDecisionRow, AttributionInstrumentLearning, AttributionInstrumentBreakdownRow, and AttributionSummary keeping the snake_case BFF keys, and src/lib/bff-v1/management.ts (adaptPerformanceAttributionResult) attaches summary when present while preserving rows and period byte-for-byte when summary is absent. src/lib/v5/management/__tests__/performanceAttribution.test.ts and src/lib/bff-v1/__tests__/contract-drift.test.ts verify both present and absent summary shapes.

ac3_portfolio_book_missing_mark_vs_no_av.detail: src/management/pages/oversight/PortfolioBook.tsx computes missingUnrealizedLabel as noAverageCostLabel only when average_price itself is null (!hasAveragePrice) and markUnavailableLabel when average_price is present (e.g., when mark_status is unavailable or stale). PortfolioBook.test.tsx verifies the real 2026-11-10 stock future row (instrument_id ssf:SRF:202611, average_price 97.1, mark_status unavailable, unrealized_pnl null, currency TWD) renders Avg entry NT$97.10 and the mark unavailable explanation ('No price available' / '無可用報價') on Unrealized PnL, and shows 'Source reports no average cost' / '來源未提供平均成本' only when average_price is null.

ac4_i18n_parity_and_existing_tests_unwea.detail: Both src/i18n/locales/en-US.ts and src/i18n/locales/zh-TW.ts carry the 27 new mgmt.attribution.* keys (4343 keys in each locale, 0 only-in-en-US, 0 only-in-zh-TW). src/lib/v5/management/__tests__/i18nParity.test.ts passes (13/13) and all existing tests in PerformanceAttribution.test.tsx and PortfolioBook.test.tsx pass without modification.
